Comparing 2‑year CAGRs, United has the highest revenue growth momentum (~12.6%), ahead of Alaska (~10.2%, boosted by the partial-year Hawaiian acquisition), Delta (~10.3%), Southwest (~7.5%), and American (~5.2%).
